$comment: U-157 thresholds, asserted over `seeds` runs by `pnpm sim-run --scenario rpg` and its test. The `squad` fight (a human lead at the low wall who never advances, five bots on the committed `friendly` tree) against one group of `riflemen` riflemen and `gunners` RPG gunners on their committed trees. Over `fightSeconds`: the squad kills at least `minRiflemanKillShare` of every rifleman spawned, across all runs, and hurts or kills a gunner in at least `minRunsGunnerHit` of runs (a gunner fighting from cover in its band outlives a squad that never advances: that is the archetype, not a failure); the gunners fire rockets in at least `minRunsWithRockets` of runs; no rocket goes off with one of their own side within its blast radius, in any run; no slot's round hurts a slot; and no more than `maxBotsDeadPerRun` bots die a run on average.
